description:

author: Russell Brand
description: Russell Brand reflects on his experience with veganism, describing how constantly hungry and unsatisfied he felt physically, before connecting that deeper sense of emptiness to faith and the teachings of Christ, as he compares physical hunger with spiritual longing and speaks about finding fulfillment, meaning, and “the bread of life” through Jesus and Christianity.
title: I never felt satisfied as a vegan.
